items.text: Ketchup, pickles, cereal, sock. Ymamot Creation!
items.where: Ymamot Creation: little Amy in the flashback (Grace's voice)
items.script: [gleeful six-year-old announcing a recipe, bossy and proud, quick; Ymamot is said YAH-mah-mott] Ketchup, pickles, cereal, sock. [beat] Ymamot Creation!

items.text: Heading out? I can come. I have a tool belt, a flashlight and a strong opinion about whatever you're about to fight.
items.where: Justin offers to join the party (Gregori house talk)
items.script: [thick New York accent, easygoing, friendly, goofy proud dad] Heading out? I can come. I have a tool belt, a flashlight and a strong opinion about whatever you're about to fight.

items.text: Great. Let me grab my jacket. And the ladder. Don't ask about the ladder.
items.script: [thick New York accent, warm, cheerful, a little distracted] Great. Let me grab my jacket. And the ladder. Don't ask about the ladder.

items.text: No problem. The hallway light won't finish itself. It's been almost done since June.
items.where: Justin when Tom says not right now
items.script: [thick New York accent, easygoing, dry, a little rueful] No problem. The hallway light won't finish itself. It's been almost done since June.

items.text: Somebody has to tag out. I'll wait. I'll be on the ladder.
items.where: Justin when the party is full and Tom must swap someone out
items.script: [thick New York accent, easygoing, relaxed, amused] Somebody has to tag out. I'll wait. I'll be on the ladder.

items.where: Foot Tap, the big spread-arms scream frame (held 1.1 s), the hit lands on it
items.script: [thick New York accent, a huge drawn-out scream of pain, arms spread, red in the face, as long and loud as the word allows] OOOUUUCH!!!!!!

items.where: Foot Tap, 2.8s, Rose taps Justin's sneaker toe (also Grace when Rose is down)
items.script: [tiny, careful, barely a whisper, mischievous] Tap.

items.where: Foot Tap, 2.8s, Grace taps Justin's sneaker toe when Rose is down
items.script: [tiny, careful, barely a whisper, mischievous] Tap.
